subject: Impact briefing: pilot outcomes and a short "hero" quote?
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@avaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Impact briefing: pilot outcomes and a short "hero" quote?

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for the partnership this month. We wrapped the 3-week POC yesterday and I wanted to share a very short impact recap and a quick favor ask. Attached is a one-page summary and a CSV with the KPI snapshots we discussed. Highlights: 

- 8.5% relative lift in add-to-cart conversion for the personalized recommendations cohort (A/B test, p<0.05)
- 42% median latency reduction at 95th percentile vs. your previous setup (from 210ms -> 122ms)
- 31% lower inference cost per 1k tokens with the quantized model running on the Dedicated pool

We put together a two-line "impact brief" for external-facing use (one-pager attached). Would you be open to: 

1) A one-sentence "hero" quote we can use on the Redwood homepage and in a short case blurb (example below).
2) A 5–10 minute call (recording optional) to capture a 1–2 sentence audio clip or confirm wording.

Example hero line (feel free to rewrite): "Redwood cut our inference latency in half and made real-time recommendations cost-effective at scale."

If that works, here's a quick Calendly to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/jonasweber/10min

Attachments: redwood_poc_summary.pdf (one-pager), pilot_data_snapshot.csv (sample KPIs)

No logos will be used without explicit approval — we can anonymize specific internal metrics if you prefer.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@avaretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Impact briefing: pilot outcomes and a short "hero" quote?

Thanks Jonas — great recap and congrats to the teams. The results look like what we hoped for, and I'm comfortable giving a short line we can use publicly. A few notes up front: please mask any sample IDs in the CSV before publishing, and we prefer our logo not to be displayed in paid ads without a final approval step.

One-line hero (draft from me):
"Redwood cut our latency in half and gave us the confidence to ship real-time recommendations without ballooning costs."

I can hop on a 10-minute call today at 1:30 PM PT to record that as a 1–2 sentence audio snippet and confirm wording. Calendly would work too but I already blocked that 1:30 slot.

Feel free to pull the sentence above into your one-pager. You have permission to attribute to Ava Retail with a high-level metric callout (conversion lift and latency reduction) as long as the underlying CSV remains internal/anonymized.

Best,

—Sasha
Sasha Nguyen
Head of ML Engineering
Ava Retail
sasha@avaretail.com

I'll update the one-pager with your sentence verbatim and remove the sample IDs from the CSV before anything is published. We will not put your logo on any paid creative without a sign-off.

Confirming: 1:30 PM PT today for the quick call. I'll send a short calendar invite and a one-click dial/record option. If anything changes, reply here or use this Calendly link: https://calendly.com/jonasweber/10min
